simple.meaning: דִּין (dîyn) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “judgement (the suit, justice, sentence or tribunal); by implication also strife.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 21 times across Deuteronomy, Esther, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, and 2 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 17:8. Its contexts include blood, Torah, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דִּין (H1779).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: דִּין (dîyn) / H1779 is traced through Deuteronomy 17:8, Esther 1:13, Job 19:29, Job 35:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: judgement (the suit, justice, sentence or tribunal); by implication also strife

firstOccurrence.englishText: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God chooses.

definitions.short: judgement (the suit, justice, sentence or tribunal); by implication also strife
definitions.full: H1779. din [ דּוּן ] noun [masculine] dubious; Qr Job 9:29 שַׁדּיּ֯ן ; see דִּין n. דִּין noun [masculine] judgment — Deut 17:8 16 t.; suffix דִּינִי Psa 9:5 , דִּינֵךְ Jer 30:13 ; — 1 דין כסא throne of judgment Prov 20:8 ; דין השׁמעת משׁמים from heaven thou didst cause judgment to be heard Psa 76:9 . 2 cause, plea , לדין דין בין between plea and plea Deut 17:8 ; דין דין plead a cause Jer 5:28 ; 22:16 ; 30:13 ; דין עשׂה maintain, the cause Psa 9:5 ; 140:13 ; דין ידע consider the cause Prov 29:7 ; לפניו דין the cause is before him Job 35:14 ; דין שׁנה change the cause Prov 31:5 ; דַּלִּים מִדִּין לְהַטּוֺת Isa 10:2 ; יתום דין Jer 5:28 ; חֲלוֺף בני כל דין Prov 31:8 . 3 judgment, condemnation , רשׁע דין judgment of the wicked Job 36:17 ; ומשׁפט דין judgment and justice 36:17 . 4 strife , וקלון דין Prov 22:10 ( legal strife, law-suit Str). 5 government , ודין דת law and government Est 1:13 . Note. — שַׁדּיּ֯ן תֵּדְעוּן לְמַעַן Job 19:29 is variously explained. (1) AV RV that ye may know there is a judgment follow Aq Symm Theod, so De Da, in interpreting שׁ relative + דִּין judgment , but שׁ is unknown to the dialect of Job and דִּין is used only in Elihu section. (2) ᵐ5 reads ὕλη , or ἴσχυς (i.e. שַׁדַּי (compare 29:5 ᵐ5 ) ? or שֹׁד ?), & Qr שַׁדּוּן , indicating ancient uncertainty and a corrupt text. (3) Ew Di read שַׁדַּי the Almighty , which accords with usage of Job. (4) Siegf שֻׁדָּ֑דוּ כִּי (doubtfully).
